payload.reason: The evidence provides clear reasoning for choosing post-editing rates over prediction (h)ter, emphasizing the completeness of time as a measure of post-editing effort and its direct applicability in real translation environments.

claims.text: Post-editing time is a more complete measure of post-editing effort than HTER, capturing both technical and cognitive effort.
Post-editing rates are directly applicable in real translation environments, relating to productivity measures.
Using point estimates alone for quality evaluation can lead to poor decision-making in translation productivity.
